name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Direct income support to land-holding farmer families, paid in three equal instalments a year straight into the beneficiary's bank account.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments of Rs 2,000, credited by DBT.

other_criteria: Family must own cultivable land recorded in their name
Income-tax payers, serving/retired government employees above Group D and pensioners drawing over Rs 10,000/month are excluded

process: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or at the nearest Common Service Centre
Get details verified by the village revenue officer
Complete Aadhaar-based eKYC
Track instalment status under 'Beneficiary Status'
keywords: farmer agriculture land crop income support rythu kisan farming cultivation

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance that compensates farmers for yield loss caused by natural calamities, pests and disease.
benefits: Insurance payout for crop loss; farmer premium capped at 2% of sum insured for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial or horticultural crops.

other_criteria: Must be growing a notified crop in a notified area
Both land-owning and tenant farmers may enrol

process: Apply through a bank, CSC or the PMFBY portal before the cut-off date for the season
Pay the farmer share of the premium
Report crop loss within 72 hours of the event
deadline: Season-wise cut-off dates (typically July for kharif, December for rabi)
keywords: crop insurance farmer drought flood pest yield loss kharif rabi

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Short-term credit for crop production, allied activities and household needs at a subsidised interest rate.
benefits: Crop loan at an effective interest rate of about 4% a year when repaid on time, thanks to interest subvention and a prompt-repayment incentive. Collateral-free up to Rs 2 lakh (RBI limit revised upward in recent years — verify current ceiling).

other_criteria: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and SHG/JLG members are eligible
Animal husbandry and fisheries activities also covered

process: Apply at any commercial bank, RRB or cooperative bank branch, or online through the bank's portal
Submit land and identity documents
Card and credit limit issued after appraisal
keywords: farm loan credit card interest subsidy crop loan dairy fisheries collateral free

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial assistance to rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, to build a pucca home.
benefits: Assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly, difficult and LWE-affected districts, plus MGNREGS wage days and a toilet under SBM-G.

other_criteria: Household must be identified as houseless or living in a kutcha house through the SECC/Awaas+ list
Families owning a pucca house, a motorised vehicle, a Kisan Credit Card above the notified limit, or paying income tax are excluded

process: Verify your name in the Awaas+ / permanent wait list at the Gram Panchayat
Complete geo-tagged registration through the Awaas Soft app
Instalments released as construction reaches each stage
deadline: Ongoing; extended by the Cabinet for further years — verify the current phase
keywords: house home rural kutcha pucca shelter housing gramin awas

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Housing support for urban poor and middle-income families through subsidised home loans, affordable housing and assistance for building on own land.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans and central assistance for affordable housing units. Slabs and quantum differ across EWS, LIG and MIG categories and across PMAY-U phases.

other_criteria: The family must not already own a pucca house anywhere in India
EWS: household income up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG: Rs 3-6 lakh; MIG slabs go higher — verify the slab for the current phase

documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Affidavit stating no pucca house is owned
process: Apply on the PMAY-U portal or through a CSC / Urban Local Body
Bank appraises the loan and claims the subsidy
Subsidy is credited upfront to the loan account
deadline: Applications reopened under PMAY-U 2.0 — verify the current window
keywords: house home urban city loan subsidy housing EWS LIG MIG flat apartment

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospital treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals for poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year, cashless and paperless, with no cap on family size or age. Covers pre-hospitalisation, hospitalisation and follow-up.

other_criteria: Families identified through the SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria, plus state-notified categories
Separately, all citizens aged 70 and above are covered under Ayushman Vay Vandana irrespective of income

documents: Ration card or family identity proof
process: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or the Ayushman app
Get the Ayushman card generated free at a CSC or empanelled hospital
Present the card at the hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk for cashless treatment
keywords: health insurance hospital treatment medical surgery illness cashless ayushman disease

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (PM-JAY for senior citizens aged 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Extension of Ayushman Bharat that covers every citizen aged 70 and above regardless of income.
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per year for the senior-citizen group within the family; existing PM-JAY families get an additional top-up for their seniors.

other_criteria: Income and social category are not a bar
Those already covered by CGHS, ECHS or ESIC must choose between the schemes

documents: Aadhaar card showing date of birth
process: Apply through the Ayushman app or the PM-JAY portal using Aadhaar eKYC
Download the Vay Vandana card
Use at any empanelled hospital
keywords: senior citizen elderly old age health insurance 70 hospital treatment

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: One-year renewable term life insurance covering death from any cause, at a very low premium.
benefits: Life cover of Rs 2 lakh for an annual premium of Rs 436, auto-debited from the bank account.

other_criteria: Must hold a savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent
Cover continues until age 55 if renewed without break

process: Give consent at your bank branch, net banking or the Jan Suraksha portal
Premium is auto-debited every year by 31 May
deadline: Enrolment open round the year; annual cover period runs 1 June to 31 May
keywords: life insurance term cover death family protection low premium bima

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
summary: Accident insurance covering accidental death and disability at a token premium.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial permanent disability, for an annual premium of Rs 20.

other_criteria: Savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent required

process: Enrol at your bank, through net banking or the Jan Suraksha portal
Premium auto-debited annually by 31 May
keywords: accident insurance disability death cover cheap premium bima suraksha

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Guaranteed minimum pension after 60 for workers in the unorganised sector who contribute regularly from a young age.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 from age 60, depending on the contribution slab chosen; same pension to the spouse after the subscriber's death and the corpus to the nominee.

other_criteria: Must have a savings bank account
Income-tax payers are not eligible to join

process: Apply at your bank branch or through net banking
Choose the pension slab and contribution frequency
Contributions are auto-debited until age 60
keywords: pension retirement old age unorganised worker savings monthly income after 60

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free institutional credit for small non-farm income-generating enterprises.
benefits: Loans under Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (up to Rs 20 lakh for past borrowers who repaid). No collateral required.

other_criteria: For non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises
Applicant should not be a defaulter with any bank

documents: Business plan or quotation for machinery
process: Apply at a bank, NBFC or MFI, or through the Jan Samarth / udyamimitra portal
Submit the business proposal
Loan sanctioned and a MUDRA card issued for working capital
keywords: business loan small enterprise shop startup self employment collateral free working capital

name: Stand-Up India
summary: Bank loans for greenfield enterprises set up by SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Composite loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore from a scheduled commercial bank for a new manufacturing, services, trading or allied-agriculture enterprise.

other_criteria: Applicant must be SC/ST or a woman aged 18 or above
Must be a greenfield (first-time) venture
For non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by an SC/ST or woman promoter

process: Register on the Stand-Up India portal or approach a bank branch directly
Submit the project report
Bank appraises and sanctions the loan
keywords: women entrepreneur sc st business loan greenfield enterprise startup manufacturing

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
summary: Credit-linked capital subsidy to help unemployed youth and artisans set up micro enterprises.
benefits: Project cost up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service units, with a margin-money subsidy of 15-35% depending on the category and whether the unit is rural or urban.

education: 8th pass or above for projects above the notified cost
other_criteria: Individuals above 18; no income ceiling for setting up the project
Only new units are eligible
Higher subsidy for SC/ST/OBC/women/ex-servicemen/PwD and North-East applicants

process: Apply online on the KVIC PMEGP e-portal
Project scrutinised by the district task force
Bank sanctions the loan and KVIC releases the margin money subsidy
deadline: Applications accepted round the year, subject to annual targets
keywords: self employment subsidy micro enterprise unemployed youth manufacturing service unit khadi

name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools across 18 recognised trades.
benefits: Recognition certificate and ID, skill training with a stipend of Rs 500 per day, a toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000, and collateral-free credit of Rs 1 lakh followed by Rs 2 lakh at a concessional 5% interest rate.

other_criteria: Must be engaged in one of the 18 notified family-based trades such as carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, cobbler, tailor, barber, washerman, mason, boat maker, toy maker, basket weaver
Only one member per family; government employees and their families are excluded

process: Register free at a Common Service Centre using Aadhaar biometric verification
Verification by the Gram Panchayat / ULB and district committee
Receive certificate, then enrol for training and credit
deadline: Registration open; scheme sanctioned for several years
keywords: artisan craftsman carpenter tailor blacksmith potter cobbler barber toolkit skill training traditional trade

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Collateral-free working capital loans for urban street vendors, with an interest subsidy and incentives for digital transactions.
benefits: First loan up to Rs 10,000, then Rs 20,000 and Rs 50,000 on timely repayment, with 7% interest subsidy and cashback for digital payments. Enhanced limits were announced in the revamped scheme — verify current ceilings.

other_criteria: Must be a street vendor with a Certificate of Vending or identified in the ULB survey
Vendors left out of the survey can get a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB

documents: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation
process: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or through a CSC, bank or ULB
ULB verifies vendor status
Loan credited to the bank account
deadline: Scheme extended — verify current end date
keywords: street vendor hawker small loan working capital cart shop footpath urban

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
summary: Legal guarantee of wage employment on public works for rural households whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: At least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household per financial year, at the state-notified MGNREGS wage rate, plus unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.

other_criteria: Adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work
No income or caste bar

documents: Proof of residence in the village
process: Apply for a job card at the Gram Panchayat
Submit a written demand for work
Work allotted within 15 days; wages paid to the bank account
keywords: job work employment daily wage labour rural village 100 days guarantee unemployment

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
summary: Monthly pension for elderly people from below-poverty-line households under the National Social Assistance Programme.
benefits: Central assistance of Rs 200 per month for ages 60-79 and Rs 500 per month from 80 onwards; most states top this up substantially from their own funds.

other_criteria: Household must belong to the BPL list as per state criteria

documents: Bank or post office account details
process: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, block office or municipal ward office, or through the state's pension portal
Verification by the local authority
Pension credited monthly by DBT
keywords: old age pension senior citizen elderly bpl poor monthly assistance 60 years

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
summary: Monthly pension for widows from below-poverty-line households.
benefits: Central assistance of Rs 300 per month for ages 40-79 and Rs 500 per month from 80 onwards, usually topped up by the state.

other_criteria: Applicant must be a widow
Household must belong to the BPL list

process: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, block or municipal office or the state pension portal
Local verification
Pension credited monthly
keywords: widow pension women husband death bpl poor monthly assistance

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
summary: Monthly pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
benefits: Central assistance of Rs 300 per month for ages 18-79 and Rs 500 per month from 80 onwards, usually topped up by the state.

other_criteria: Disability of 80% or more (severe or multiple disability)
Household must belong to the BPL list

process: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, block or municipal office or the state pension portal
Medical board and local verification
Pension credited monthly
keywords: disability pension handicapped divyang bpl poor monthly assistance severe disability

name: ADIP - Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase of Aids and Appliances
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Free or subsidised assistive devices such as hearing aids, prosthetics, wheelchairs, tricycles and smart canes for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Aids and appliances supplied free where monthly income is up to Rs 22,500, and at 50% cost where income is between Rs 22,501 and Rs 30,000. Verify the current income slabs.

other_criteria: Disability of 40% or more certified by a competent authority
Monthly family income within the notified ceiling

process: Register on the ADIP or UDID portal, or attend an ALIMCO assessment camp
Assessment by the medical team
Device distributed at a camp or implementing agency
keywords: disability wheelchair hearing aid prosthetic artificial limb tricycle divyang assistive device

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: A single nationally valid disability certificate and ID card that unlocks most other disability benefits, concessions and reservations.
benefits: Nationally valid disability certificate, smart card and online record; required to claim disability pensions, scholarships, ADIP aids, rail and bus concessions and reservation in jobs and education.

other_criteria: Any person with a disability listed under the RPwD Act, 2016

process: Apply on the UDID portal
Attend assessment at the notified government hospital
Certificate and card issued and delivered
keywords: disability certificate card divyang udid identity handicapped percentage

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: Maternity benefit that partly compensates pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage loss and encourages institutional care.
benefits: Rs 5,000 in instalments for the first living child, and Rs 6,000 for the second child if it is a girl, paid by DBT.

other_criteria: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19 or above
Excludes women in regular employment with the central or state government or PSUs who receive similar paid maternity benefits

documents: Aadhaar card of mother and husband
Bank account in the mother's name
Child birth certificate for later instalments
process: Register at the Anganwadi centre or approved health facility, or apply on the PMMVY soft portal
Submit MCP card details at each instalment stage
Amount credited by DBT
deadline: Apply within the notified period after pregnancy registration
keywords: pregnant women maternity mother child birth lactating benefit cash girl child

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Cash assistance to encourage institutional delivery among poor pregnant women, along with ASHA support.
benefits: Cash assistance of Rs 1,400 for rural and Rs 1,000 for urban mothers in low-performing states, with lower amounts in high-performing states, plus an incentive to the ASHA worker.

other_criteria: Pregnant women, with BPL or SC/ST status required in high-performing states and universal coverage in low-performing states

documents: BPL or caste certificate where required
process: Register the pregnancy at the health sub-centre or with the ASHA worker
Deliver at a government or accredited private facility
Cash paid at discharge or by DBT
keywords: pregnancy delivery hospital mother institutional birth asha cash assistance

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: Free LPG connection for women from poor households, to replace polluting cooking fuel.
benefits: Free deposit-free LPG connection with the first refill and stove provided free, plus a per-cylinder subsidy for Ujjwala beneficiaries.

other_criteria: Adult woman from a poor household as identified by SECC, SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY, forest dweller, most backward class, tea garden or island categories, or through a self-declaration of poor household status
No other LPG connection may exist in the household

process: Apply at any LPG distributor or on the Ujjwala portal
Document verification by the distributor
Connection issued with stove and first refill
deadline: Extended under Ujjwala 2.0 — verify the current window
keywords: lpg gas cylinder cooking fuel women household kitchen connection free

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
summary: Small savings account for a girl child with a high fixed interest rate and full tax exemption, meant for her education and marriage.
benefits: Attractive government-notified interest rate, deposits eligible for deduction under Section 80C and interest and maturity fully tax free. Deposit between Rs 250 and Rs 1.5 lakh a year.

other_criteria: Account opened by a parent or guardian for a girl child below the age of 10
Maximum two accounts per family, with an exception for twins or triplets

documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar and PAN of the guardian
process: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank branch
Deposit for 15 years
Partial withdrawal allowed at 18 for education; maturity at 21
keywords: girl child daughter savings education marriage interest tax deposit account beti

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC / ST Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
summary: Full support for SC and ST students studying at or above class 11, covering fees and maintenance.
benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance, with amounts varying by course group and whether the student is a hosteller or day scholar.

other_criteria: Annual family income must be within the notified ceiling (commonly Rs 2.5 lakh)
Student must be studying in a recognised institution at post-matriculation level

process: Register on the National Scholarship Portal during the application window
Institution verifies the application
Amount credited by DBT
deadline: Usually between July and October each academic year — verify on NSP
keywords: scholarship sc st student college fees education degree intermediate stipend caste

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC / EBC / DNT Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Fee and maintenance support for OBC, economically backward and denotified tribe students studying beyond class 10.
benefits: Course fee reimbursement and a monthly maintenance allowance for hostellers and day scholars.

other_criteria: Annual family income within the notified ceiling
Studying at post-matriculation level in a recognised institution

process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal
Institutional and state verification
Amount credited by DBT
deadline: Annual NSP window, usually July to October
keywords: scholarship obc student college fees education backward class stipend

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme (PM-YASASVI)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Merit-based scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students in classes 9 and 11, selected through an entrance test.
benefits: Annual scholarship covering school fees and expenses for selected students in class 9 and class 11 at recognised schools.

other_criteria: Family income within the notified ceiling
Selection through the YASASVI entrance test conducted by NTA

process: Register for the YASASVI entrance test on the NTA portal
Appear for the test
Selected students apply on NSP for disbursal
keywords: scholarship school student class 9 class 11 obc merit entrance test

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
summary: Scholarship encouraging girls to pursue technical education in AICTE-approved degree and diploma programmes.
benefits: Rs 50,000 per year towards tuition fee and purchase of books, equipment and other expenses, for the duration of the course.

other_criteria: Admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved degree or diploma programme, or through lateral entry
Family income within the notified ceiling (commonly Rs 8 lakh)
Not more than two girls per family

documents: Admission proof in an AICTE-approved institution
process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal under AICTE schemes
Institute verifies enrolment
Scholarship credited by DBT
keywords: girl student engineering diploma technical scholarship aicte women btech college fees

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
summary: Scholarship enabling differently-abled students to pursue AICTE-approved technical education.
benefits: Rs 50,000 per year towards fees, books and other expenses for the duration of the course.

other_criteria: Disability of 40% or more
Admitted to the first year or through lateral entry into an AICTE-approved programme
Family income within the notified ceiling

process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal under AICTE schemes
Institute verification
DBT credit
keywords: disabled student engineering diploma technical scholarship aicte divyang college

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
summary: Scholarship to stop bright students from poor families dropping out at class 8 and to help them complete secondary schooling.
benefits: Rs 12,000 per year paid from class 9 to class 12 to selected students.

other_criteria: Studying in a government, local body or government-aided school
Family income within the notified ceiling
Selection through the state-level NMMS examination

process: Appear for the state NMMS selection test in class 8
Apply on the National Scholarship Portal after selection
Renew each year subject to marks and attendance
deadline: State test notification, usually late in the year
keywords: school scholarship class 8 class 9 government school dropout merit poor student

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
summary: One hot cooked meal every school day for children in government and government-aided schools.
benefits: Free hot cooked mid-day meal meeting prescribed calorie and protein norms for children from Balvatika to class 8.

other_criteria: Enrolled in a government, local body or government-aided school or special training centre

documents: Aadhaar of the child where available
process: Automatic on enrolment in an eligible school — no separate application
keywords: school meal food children nutrition mid day meal free lunch student

name: National Food Security Act - Subsidised Foodgrain (PHH / AAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
summary: Legal entitlement to subsidised or free foodgrain through the public distribution system, portable across India.
benefits: 5 kg of foodgrain per person per month for Priority Households and 35 kg per household for Antyodaya Anna Yojana families, currently free under PMGKAY. One Nation One Ration Card allows collection anywhere in India.

other_criteria: Household identified as Priority Household or Antyodaya by the state government under NFSA coverage norms
Up to 75% of rural and 50% of urban population is covered nationally

process: Apply for a ration card at the district food and civil supplies office or the state PDS portal
Verification by the local food inspector
Collect grain from the fair price shop using biometric authentication
keywords: ration card food grain rice wheat free pds poor household bpl antyodaya

name: e-Shram - National Database of Unorganised Workers
summary: Universal registration of unorganised workers, giving each worker a Universal Account Number that links them to social security schemes.
benefits: Free UAN card, accidental insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh under PMSBY for the first year, and single-window access to other welfare schemes.

other_criteria: Worker in the unorganised sector
Must not be an EPFO or ESIC member or an income-tax payer

documents: Aadhaar card with linked mobile number
process: Self-register on the e-Shram portal or through a CSC
Aadhaar OTP verification
Download the e-Shram card with the UAN
keywords: unorganised worker labour card registration uan daily wage domestic worker construction

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
summary: Free short-term skill training and certification for youth, with recognition of prior learning for existing workers.
benefits: Free short-term training in industry-relevant job roles, government-recognised certification, and placement support.

other_criteria: School or college dropouts and unemployed youth are the priority group
Candidate must hold Aadhaar and a bank account

process: Register on the Skill India Digital portal
Choose a job role and a nearby training centre
Complete training and assessment to get certified
keywords: skill training course free certification job placement youth unemployed vocational

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
summary: Placement-linked skill training for poor rural youth, with free residential training and a guaranteed placement component.
benefits: Fully funded training, boarding and lodging, plus post-placement support; at least 70% of trained candidates must be placed in wage employment.

other_criteria: Poor rural youth identified through SECC, MGNREGS worker households, NRLM SHG households or the Antyodaya list
Upper age limit relaxed for women and vulnerable groups

process: Register at a DDU-GKY training partner or on the Kaushal Panjee portal
Counselling and enrolment in a batch
Training, assessment and placement
keywords: rural youth skill training placement job free residential course village employment

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
summary: Organises rural poor women into self-help groups and links them to bank credit, revolving funds and livelihood support.
benefits: Revolving fund and community investment support to SHGs, and bank loans at an interest-subvented rate of about 7%, with a further rebate for prompt repayment in many states. Lakhpati Didi initiatives support higher household incomes.

other_criteria: Women from poor rural households, mobilised into a self-help group
Group must maintain regular savings, meetings and repayment discipline

process: Join or form an SHG through the village organisation
Group completes the grading process
Bank linkage and credit sanctioned
keywords: women shg self help group rural loan livelihood savings lakhpati didi village

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Seed funding for early-stage startups to test proof of concept, build prototypes and enter the market.
benefits: Up to Rs 20 lakh as a grant for proof of concept or prototype development, and up to Rs 50 lakh for market entry and scaling through convertible debentures or debt.

other_criteria: Must be a DPIIT-recognised startup incorporated not more than 2 years before applying
Should not have received more than Rs 10 lakh of other government monetary support
Indian promoters must hold at least 51% shareholding

process: Get DPIIT startup recognition
Apply on the Startup India seed fund portal choosing up to three incubators
Incubator evaluates and disburses in milestones
deadline: Applications open round the year through incubators
keywords: startup funding seed grant prototype entrepreneur business idea incubator innovation

name: PM Internship Scheme
summary: Paid internships with India's top companies for young people who are not in full-time education or employment.
benefits: Monthly stipend of Rs 5,000 (Rs 4,500 from the government and Rs 500 from the company) plus a one-time grant of Rs 6,000, for a 12-month internship.

other_criteria: Must have passed class 10 or 12, or hold an ITI certificate, diploma or a degree such as BA, BSc, BCom, BCA, BBA or BPharma
Not in full-time employment or full-time education
No family member should be an income-tax payer or a permanent government employee; family income up to Rs 8 lakh

process: Register on the PM Internship portal and complete the profile
Apply to available internship opportunities
Companies shortlist and issue offers
deadline: Round-wise application windows — verify current round
keywords: internship stipend graduate student fresher training company job experience youth

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
summary: Subsidy for installing rooftop solar panels on residential houses, aimed at giving households free or near-free electricity.
benefits: Central subsidy of Rs 30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and Rs 18,000 for the third kW, capped at Rs 78,000 for a 3 kW system, plus collateral-free low-interest loans.

other_criteria: Must be an Indian household owning a roof suitable for solar panels
Valid electricity connection required
Household must not have availed another solar subsidy

process: Register on the National Portal for Rooftop Solar and apply through your DISCOM
Get installation done by a registered vendor
Apply for net metering, then subsidy is credited to the bank account
keywords: solar rooftop electricity bill free power subsidy house energy panel

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
summary: Functional tap water connection to every rural household.
benefits: Piped tap water connection to the household, with assured quantity and quality; the community contributes a small share of the capital cost.

other_criteria: Rural households in villages covered under the mission

process: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or Village Water and Sanitation Committee
Village water supply scheme approved and executed
Tap connection provided to the household
deadline: Mission timeline extended — verify current status
keywords: water tap connection drinking water rural village household pipe supply

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
summary: Zero-balance bank account for every household, bundled with a RuPay card, overdraft and accident cover.
